### 🔵 Needs a closer look The new integration test assumes XAUTOCLAIM COUNT 0 succeeds with an empty result, but that behavior remains unverified against the supported Upstash backend. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR fixes Redis command construction so explicit zero and empty-string arguments are preserved, and corrects when XCLAIM emits `TIME`. **Changes:** - Fix XCLAIM’s `TIME` guard and preserve zero-valued claim options. - Preserve zero or empty arguments in expiration, geospatial, stream, and scan commands. - Add regression tests and patch-release changesets. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​zscan.ts` | Preserve empty `MATCH` patterns. | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​zscan.test.ts` | Test matching an empty sorted-set member. | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​xtrim.ts` | Include explicit `LIMIT 0`. | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​xtrim.test.ts` | Test trimming with `LIMIT 0`. | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​xclaim.ts` | Correct the `TIME` guard and retain zero options. | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​xclaim.test.ts` | Verify independent time options and zero-valued arguments. | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​xautoclaim.ts` | Forward explicit zero counts. | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​xautoclaim.test.ts` | Add a zero-count claim test. | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​sscan.ts` | Preserve empty `MATCH` patterns. | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​sscan.test.ts` | Test matching an empty set member. | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​scan.ts` | Preserve empty `MATCH` patterns. | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​hscan.ts` | Preserve empty `MATCH` patterns. | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​hscan.test.ts` | Test matching an empty hash field. | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​geo_add.ts` | Retain the first member when latitude is zero. | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​geo_add.test.ts` | Test adding a member at latitude zero. | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​expire.ts` | Filter only undefined arguments. | | `packages/​redis/​pkg/​commands/​expire.test.ts` | Test immediate expiration with zero seconds. | | `.changeset/​fix-xclaim-time.md` | Document the XCLAIM patch. | | `.changeset/​fix-dropped-falsy-arguments.md` | Document the broader argument-preservation fixes. |
Review effort: Balanced

comments.body:
Thanks for the fix. I went through the other commands for the same kind of problem (a valid zero or empty value being dropped by a truthiness check) and pushed the ones I found to this branch, so they can ship together. I also merged `main` into the branch.

Added in 9fbc4c6:

| Command | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|
| `expire(key, 0)` | `seconds` was dropped and the server returned a wrong-number-of-arguments error | sent as is, the key is deleted |
| `geoadd` | a first member with `latitude: 0` was not added | added |
| `xtrim` | `limit: 0` was dropped, so the default eviction limit applied | `LIMIT 0` is sent |
| `xautoclaim` | `count: 0` was dropped, so up to the default number of entries were claimed | `COUNT 0` is sent |
| `hscan`, `sscan`, `zscan` | `match: ""` was dropped and everything was returned | `MATCH ""` is sent |
| `scan` | same check as above | changed for consistency |

Each fix has a test that fails without it and passes with it, except `scan`: an empty pattern makes no observable difference there, so that one has no test.

One behavior change to be aware of: `xtrim` with `exactness: "="` and `limit: 0` now gets the server's `LIMIT cannot be used without the special ~ option` error. Before, the `0` was silently dropped.
